subject: maths
question: Ram travelled from a place Z to P at an average speed of 130 km/h. He travelled the first 75% of the distance in two-third of the time and the rest at an average speed of X kmh. The value of (x)/(2) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Average speed = 130 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be y km

Time is taken by him = y/130 h

75% of the distance = 75% of y = (3/4)y

Time is taken by him to complete the distance of y km = (y/130) × (2/3) = y/195

Rest distance = y - (3y/4) = y/4

Time taken by him = (y/130) - (y/195) = y/390

Now,

According to the question,

X = (y/4)/(y/390)

⇒ X = 390/4 km

⇒ X = 97.5 km

So, x/2 = 97.5/2

⇒ 48.75

**∴ The value of (x)/(2) is 48.75.**
